Qinghe Chinese redistributes CC-CEDICT fields for traditional Chinese,
simplified Chinese, numbered-tone pinyin, and English definitions. The source
records are converted to a compact JSON array representation for browser use.
This redistributed dictionary dataset remains available under CC BY-SA 4.0.

Qinghe Chinese's separately identified learner explanations, HSK labels,
collocations, lesson content, and original example sentences are not copied
from CC-CEDICT.
